name: thinkcomposer
description: Work with ThinkComposer .tcom containers, JSON interchange, application logs, and embedded or exported view images.

interface.shortDescription: Read .tcom containers, JSON, logs, and images
interface.longDescription: ThinkComposer lets Codex collaborate with the desktop diagramming app by reading modern .tcom containers with embedded interchange JSON and previews, reading standalone Composition and Domain JSON, writing safe import patches, inspecting copied application logs, and finding embedded or exported view images for visual verification.
